tools.name: audio_play
tools.description: Start playing an audio file through the local speakers and return at once. The audio comes from a local file path or a log:/mem: handle, such as the path or handle returned by tts_speak. It only plays sound; it does not send anything. A playback failure arrives later as an audio-play.failed event.

audio.description: Audio file path (absolute, or relative to the bot workspace) or a log:/mem: handle, e.g. the path or log: handle returned by tts_speak.

volume.description: Playback volume 0–100 for this call; omit to use the configured volume.

summary.zh: 把一段音频（本地文件或 log:/mem: 句柄，比如 tts_speak 回执里的那个）交给本机扬声器，开始播放后立刻返回；失败会发 audio-play.failed 事件，成功不再回报。
summary.en: Start playing an audio file or a log:/mem: handle (such as the one returned by tts_speak) through the local speakers and return at once; a failure arrives later as an audio-play.failed event, and success is silent.

tools.name: audio_watch
tools.description: Read or change playback settings. start turns on automatic playback of event audio for the configured event types (tts.voice by default) and plays new events that carry an audio attachment; stop turns it off; set changes the watched event types and/or the playback backend without changing whether watching is on; status shows the settings and last playback. Every change is saved to the config. Playback failures arrive as audio-play.failed events; success is silent.

action.description: start = watch new events and play their audio; stop = stop watching; set = change the watched types and/or the playback backend; status = show the current settings.

events.description: For start and set: comma-separated event types to watch, e.g. tts.voice. For start it defaults to the configured list.

backend.description: For start and set: the playback backend. auto = platform default; wpf = Windows system player; ffplay, mpv, vlc, afplay, paplay, aplay = that command; custom = the command configured in the settings.

summary.zh: 打开或关闭事件音频的自动播放，更换监听的事件类型或播放后端，或查看当前设置；播放新事件里的音频附件。
summary.en: Turn automatic playback of event audio on or off, change the watched event types or the playback backend, or read the current settings; plays audio attachments on new events.

description.zh: 播放失败：正文带音频来源、音量与原因，没有附件；手动播放和自动播放失败都会发，成功不发。
description.en: A failed playback: the text carries the audio reference, volume and reason, with no attachment; both manual and watched playback emit it, success is silent.
